description_en: This operation is not recommended now. The billing method for bandwidth of a Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) instance is changed to pay-as-you-go
description_zh: 云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的带宽已升级为按量付费模式，不再推荐使用本接口
name: RenewAdditionalBandwidth

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473778.html operation to query the ID of the instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Default value: true. Valid values:

true: enables automatic payment.
false: disables automatic payment. If automatic payment is disabled, you must perform the following steps to complete the payment in the Tair (Redis OSS-compatible) console: In the top navigation bar, choose Expenses > Renewal Management. In the left-side navigation pane, click Orders. On the Orders page, find the order and complete the payment
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动付费。取值：

true：自动付费，默认值。
false：手动付费。您需要在控制台的顶部菜单栏，单击费用 > 续费管理，然后单击左侧导航栏的订单管理 > 我的订单，找到目标订单进行支付
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en: The validity period of the bandwidth that you purchase. Unit: days. Valid values: 1, 2, 3, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 180, 365, 730, 1095, and 1825
parameters.name: order_time_length

parameters.help_en: The source of the operation. This parameter is used only for internal maintenance. You do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 调用来源，本参数仅用于内部维护使用，无需传入
parameters.name: source_biz
